queries_run: ANET Arista Networks antitrust OR DOJ OR FTC OR EU competition investigation 2026

findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 風險因素僅泛稱可能收到政府機關詢問並導致正式調查，未點名任何針對 Arista 的反壟斷調查；搜尋亦未見 2026 年 DOJ／FTC／EU 對 ANET 的調查。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: From time to time, we may receive inquiries from governmental agencies, or we may make voluntary disclosures regarding our compliance with applicable governmental regulations or requirements relating to various matters, including import/export controls, federal securities laws and tax laws and regulations which could lead to formal investigations.

regulatory_antitrust.note: 搜尋結果只見 Arista 與 Cisco 舊案（約 2018 年和解），無 2026 年反壟斷調查。
